Frequently asked questions
Start Free Book a Demo
What is the Frontdesk AI brain? + It is a shared memory that sits behind every channel. Each call, text, email, and chat is turned into structured data on the customer: who they are, what they want, and when to act. Every future conversation and every automated follow-up draws on that same memory.
What data does it extract from conversations? + Intent, timing, sentiment, budget, and any custom field you define in plain English. You describe the field and how to compute it, and the brain fills it out after every conversation. Those fields power your analytics and trigger your outbound flows.
What is an AI customer platform? + An AI customer platform is a single system of AI agents that handle customer conversations across voice, text and chat, then remember and follow up automatically. Frontdesk is an agentic AI customer platform: it answers calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, updates your CRM and follows up, across every channel.
What can agentic AI do across the customer journey? + Agentic AI can take actions, not just answer questions. It can pick up a call, capture the details, book the meeting, log the record and trigger the follow-up without a human in the loop. Frontdesk runs that full loop for customer-facing teams, from first call to CRM update.
What is an AI receptionist? + An AI receptionist is a voice agent that answers every call 24/7, qualifies the caller and books the appointment. Frontdesk's AI receptionist also texts, emails and chats from the same memory, and it is where most Frontdesk customers start.
What is an AI receptionist? + An AI receptionist is software that answers your business phone, replies to texts and emails, and handles customer inquiries the way a trained human receptionist would. It greets callers in natural language, qualifies leads, books appointments on your calendar, captures contact details into your CRM, and escalates anything it cannot handle to a human. Unlike a phone tree or IVR, an AI receptionist holds a real conversation and works 24/7 without breaks.
How does an AI receptionist work? + You forward your existing business number to Frontdesk and describe what your AI receptionist should say and do. When a customer calls, the AI answers in a natural voice, follows your instructions, looks up information from your knowledge base, books appointments against your live calendar, and writes every interaction to your CRM. If the call needs a human, it warm-transfers or sends a real-time alert with a full transcript.
How much does an AI receptionist cost? + Frontdesk's AI receptionist starts free and scales by usage. The Free plan covers limited monthly minutes with no credit card, paid plans add more minutes, advanced integrations, and concurrent calls, and the Enterprise plan covers high-volume operators and multi-location businesses with custom pricing. Most customers replace thousands of dollars in monthly answering-service or staffing costs.
Is the AI receptionist better than a traditional answering service? + A traditional answering service routes calls to a human agent who reads a script, charges per minute, and is unavailable outside business hours. Frontdesk’s AI receptionist answers instantly 24/7, never puts a caller on hold, books appointments directly, integrates with your CRM and calendar, and costs a fraction of a live-agent service. It also handles unlimited concurrent calls, so nothing goes to voicemail at peak hours.
What is Frontdesk? + Frontdesk is an AI-powered front office platform for small and medium businesses. It includes an AI phone receptionist, web chatbot, SMS agent, CRM, calendar, and more, all working together. Your AI answers calls 24/7, qualifies leads, books appointments, and handles routine inquiries just like a trained human employee.
How long does setup take? + Less than 5 minutes. Enter your website URL or describe your business, and our AI builds your receptionist automatically. You can go live with a forwarded phone number and embedded chatbot the same day, no engineers, no agencies, no waiting.
Can I try it before paying? + Yes. The Free plan gives you full access to the AI workforce with limited monthly usage, no credit card required. You can also call our AI demo line at +1 (864) 619-0619 to hear it in action, or book a free call with our customer success team.
Does it integrate with my existing CRM? + Frontdesk has its own built-in CRM, but it also integrates with popular tools via Zapier and direct API connections. If you're on an Enterprise plan, custom integrations are available, every interaction (call, chat, SMS) is automatically logged wherever you need it.
What happens when the AI can't answer a question? + Frontdesk is built with enterprise-grade escalation logic. When the AI encounters a complex case it cannot handle, it escalates to a human supervisor in real-time with a full transcript. You can configure escalation rules, approval workflows, and notification recipients from the dashboard.
Do you have an enterprise plan? + Yes. Our Partner/Enterprise plan is designed for businesses handling 25+ interactions per day, call centers, and multi-location operators. It includes volume discounts, API access, custom integrations, a dedicated account manager, white-glove onboarding, and a dedicated Slack channel. Book a call with our sales team for a custom demo.
Can I keep my existing phone number? + Yes. You can forward your existing business number to Frontdesk so all calls are handled by the AI. Your customers dial the same number they always have. They just get an always-available, always-professional AI receptionist.

The New York team in the Soho office.
Made in Soho, New York
We are rebuilding customer communication for the AI age .
For most businesses, handling customer interactions is extremely painful. We started Frontdesk because the tools meant to help were making it harder.
Headquarters
New York City
Backing
Backed by the early investors in DoorDash and Gusto
What we believe.
01 Simplicity, first.
Working with Frontdesk should feel like talking to your favorite coworker, not configuring software. We hide the complexity so it just gets the job done, the way you already work, from day one.
02 Enterprise power at any size.
The best software has always been locked behind big ops teams, long setups, and enterprise budgets. We give a team of five the same power as a team of five hundred, without any of that overhead.
03 Deliver revenue, measurably.
We only make money when we make you money. Old software charges you to store your data. We charge for work done, the calls handled, the chats answered, the meetings booked.
04 Customer pain writes the roadmap.
We build what we hear on calls with customers, not what looks good in a planning deck. The sharpest pain ships first.
For most businesses, the hardest part is not the work. It is everything around it. Customers reach you on calls, texts, emails, chats, and forms. Some are brand new, some have been with you for years. Keeping every relationship straight, across every channel, becomes a full time job of its own.
The tools meant to fix this were built for the largest companies, with the ops teams and budgets to run them. Everyone else glues a dozen apps together, loses context between them, and watches a real share of revenue walk out the door. The whole stack assumed a person at a desk, typing into forms.
Why our founder left Meta to build Frontdesk. Read the story in Business Insider Then AI got good enough to read a message, understand a customer, and handle it on any channel. So we started over. Frontdesk meets your customers everywhere and writes it all to one CRM, live in minutes. The software should learn your business, not the other way around.
We want to rethink the whole stack for AI, so business owners can get back to running their business.
We are a global team headquartered in Soho, New York, building for the businesses that run the economy and have been ignored by software for too long.

1. Introduction and Scope
This Privacy Policy ("Policy") is established by AI Front Desk, Inc. ("Company," "we," "us," or "our"), a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business in California, United States. This Policy describes how we collect, use, store, process, disclose, and protect information, including personal information, obtained from users ("you" or "your") of our website https://www.myaifrontdesk.com, our AI phone receptionist services, and any related products or services (collectively, the "Services").
By accessing or using the Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Policy and agree to the practices described herein. This Policy is incorporated into and subject to our Terms and Conditions .
2. Information We Collect
2.1 Personal Information
We may collect the following categories of personal information:
Identifiers such as name, email address, postal address, account identifiers, IP address, or similar identifiers
Commercial information such as records of services purchased or considered
Audio and electronic information, including call recordings, voicemails, and transcripts
Professional or employment related information voluntarily provided to us
2.2 Usage and Technical Data
We automatically collect certain information when you interact with our Services, including:
Website usage data, logs, and traffic information
Device and connection data such as browser type, operating system, and IP address
Call logs, message logs, timestamps, and related metadata
2.3 Cookies and Tracking Technologies
We use cookies and similar technologies to operate and improve the Services. These may include:
Session cookies necessary for functionality
Preference cookies to store user settings
Security cookies to protect accounts and systems
Analytics and advertising cookies to understand usage and improve marketing efforts
You may control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may limit certain features.
2.4 Location Data
If enabled on your device, we may collect approximate location data to improve service functionality. You may disable location sharing at any time through your device settings.
3. How We Use Information
3.1 Core Uses
We use collected information to:
Provide, operate, and maintain the Services
Manage accounts, billing, and customer support

FAQ
AI receptionist pricing questions, answered
Everything you need to know about AI receptionist pricing, the AI workforce included in every plan, usage credits, billing, and upgrades.
Contact support
How much does an AI receptionist cost? A Frontdesk plan that answers phone calls costs $99 per month on Business-in-a-Box, or $79 per month billed annually, and includes 200 voice minutes alongside chat, SMS, CRM, and automations. Partner and Enterprise pricing is custom and set by monthly volume.
How much does an AI receptionist cost per month? Frontdesk bills $99 per month for Business-in-a-Box, with no contract and no per-seat or per-call fees. Paying annually takes 20% off, which brings it to $79 per month billed upfront. Business-in-a-Box also carries a pool of 1,000 overage credits each month, and auto-reload adds 1,000 more for $10 if you run out.
How much do virtual receptionists cost? Published prices for AI virtual receptionists start at around $14 per month and rise with the minutes included. ai-receptionist.com advertises plans from $14 per month, Allo from $18 per month, AgentZap from $25 per month, and NextPhone between $199 and $299 per month. Frontdesk charges $99 per month for Business-in-a-Box, the plan that answers phone calls, or $79 per month billed annually.
What is the cheapest AI receptionist? The cheapest advertised plans in this category sit under $20 per month, with ai-receptionist.com from $14 per month and Allo from $18 per month. Entry tiers are limited by their minute allowance, so compare what each plan includes rather than the headline price alone. The lowest Frontdesk plan that answers calls is Business-in-a-Box at $99 per month, which includes 200 voice minutes plus chat, SMS, CRM, and automations rather than voice alone.
Is there a free AI receptionist? Frontdesk does not offer a permanently free plan. Paid plans start at $99 per month for Business-in-a-Box, which is the entry point for answering calls and includes 200 voice minutes plus chat, SMS, CRM, and automations. If you are comparing against a free tier elsewhere, check how many minutes or calls it actually includes.
Is an AI receptionist worth it? It depends on how many calls you currently miss and what one booked customer is worth to you. Business-in-a-Box costs a fixed $99 per month and covers nights, weekends, and holidays, so the comparison to run is that figure against the revenue sitting in calls that currently go to voicemail. A business with low call volume and full phone coverage during opening hours gets less from it than one whose phone rings outside staffed hours.
How much should I charge for an AI receptionist? You set the price entirely. Frontdesk partners buy at a wholesale rate, resell under their own brand, and control tiering, minute packages, and usage-based billing through the built-in Stripe integration, with no price floor or ceiling imposed by the platform. Frontdesk white-label partner plans are custom and start at $500 per month. See the white-label page for how the reseller program works.
What does an AI receptionist cost for a small business? Business-in-a-Box at $99 per month is the plan built for small businesses, or $79 per month billed annually. It covers 1 to 10 interactions per day and includes 200 voice minutes, 100 chat conversations, 400 SMS messages, 500 email drafts, and 300 website form submissions each month. Businesses running more than 25 interactions a day move to Partner or Enterprise pricing, which is quoted on volume.
What happens if I use more than my included voice minutes? Business-in-a-Box includes 200 voice minutes a month; after that, each extra minute draws 25 credits ($0.25) from the plan's monthly pool of 1,000 overage credits, which covers about 40 more minutes. Unused pool credits expire at the end of the month. If the pool runs out, auto-reload adds 1,000 credits for $10, and purchased credits never expire. Partner and Enterprise plans pay a lower per-minute rate.
Which Frontdesk plan includes API access and integrations? Every plan connects to calendars, CRMs and thousands of other apps through Zapier, including Business-in-a-Box at $99 per month. Direct API access, custom work, priority support and a dedicated account manager are part of Partner and Enterprise, which are priced on volume. There are no separate Starter or Pro tiers.
